descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Reading and Interpreting Graphs (D1.1-D1.5)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 3 unit on data framed around Detective Dot and Tally. Children sort by 3 attributes (tree diagrams), build frequency tables, use many-to-one scale, calculate mean, and write conclusions.
long_description: Detective Dot and Tally tackle their Grade 3 Big Case! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 3 unit covers all 5 D1 expectations (D1.1-D1.5) building on G2 unit. Day 1 introduces TREE DIAGRAMS for 3-attribute sorting. Day 2 builds frequency tables (qualitative + quantitative). Day 3 introduces MANY-TO-ONE SCALE on bar graphs. Day 4 introduces MEAN (total ÷ count). Day 5 closes with a Big Case Capstone. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-3 trap: cross-branching tree, qual/quant mix-up, scale-blind reading, wrong-divisor mean, no-measure conclusion), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 5-row summative rubric, and Junior Data Detective G3 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day data unit (D1.1-D1.5).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on data investigation with character-driven detective frame, structured pair work, and progressive complexity from G1/G2 units.
